note: NECO Marketing Paper III round 1: the SSCE syllabus - marketing concepts (needs, wants, demand, exchange), segmentation (demographic, geographic, behavioural, psychographic), the marketing mix (4Ps + services), product and branding (life cycle, packaging, labels), pricing (cost-plus, skimming, penetration, psychological, captive), channels (exclusive/intensive), promotion (advertising, personal selling, sales promotion, publicity, PR), consumer behaviour (buying process, motives, dissonance, loyalty), market research (questionnaire, observation, test market, primary data) and e-commerce/customer care. Near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
